notes: 点 × 检测到待拉取/待推送后主动退出 DSH 并立即执行：0.3.96 的信标已经能判一次并排好 watcher，但 watcher 进入 wait 后是被动等 DSH 进程全消失才开工，实测点 × 常残留 7 个进程、只能干等到 30 分钟超时。这次补上最后一环：handleAutoExit 一旦 triggerAutoSyncOnClose 返回 queued:true（确实有待同步），立即从独立 detached 进程用 taskkill /IM "DeepSeek Harness.exe" /F 整族强杀（ping -n 3 留 2 秒给正常关闭落盘），watcher 立刻进入 run。必须在独立进程做——强杀会带走插件自己（host 子进程），插件进程内的 setTimeout 来不及执行；且只在 queued 时才退出，没待同步点 × 不误杀 DSH。selftest 加断言防回归。保留 0.3.93/0.3.94/0.3.95/0.3.96 全部修复。
notesEn: Clicking × with pending changes now actively exits DSH and syncs immediately: 0.3.96's beacon could check once and queue the watcher, but the watcher then sat in wait passively waiting for all DSH processes to disappear; in practice clicking × leaves 7 orphaned processes and the watcher idled until its 30-minute timeout. This version closes the last gap: once triggerAutoSyncOnClose returns queued:true (something is really pending), handleAutoExit immediately force-kills the whole DSH process family from an independent detached process via taskkill /IM "DeepSeek Harness.exe" /F (ping -n 3 gives ~2s for the normal close to flush). It must run detached — force-killing takes down the plugin itself (host child), so no in-plugin setTimeout would survive; and it only fires when queued, so clicking × with nothing pending won't kill DSH. selftest assertions added. Keeps all 0.3.93/0.3.94/0.3.95/0.3.96 fixes.
